_comment: 8e Phase C, the bureaucratic chain (issue #16, controller ruling 1/6) -- the forge-tier permit clerk, beats 'apply' and 'stamped' of quests.json's forge_tier_permit. DORMANT: no scene entity carries `conversation: "pallass_forge_clerk"` yet -- Phase B's own parallel worktree lane owns pallass_forge's actual map/entity placement; this clerk's OWN reachability constraint (must be reachable from the market tier, pre-elevator -- the elevator door pair's door_when gates on THIS quest's own completion, so the clerk who starts the chain can't sit behind the very gate the chain unlocks) is forward-referenced for B/D's reconciliation, see docs/design/pallass-staging/phase-c-forward-references.json. Sprite (once wired): `tier_clerk` (8e Phase A rig, same 'one rig reused at every desk' civic-uniformity tell as pallass_market_clerk -- a DIFFERENT desk, same actor convention). Copy below is STRUCTURALLY COMPLETE PLACEHOLDER -- D-phase replaces with clerk voice-pass copy before merge; gates/costs are real, not draft.

hub.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
hub.text: State your business and your sponsor, or stand aside for the next in line.

options._comment: Quest-start (forge_tier_permit) -- HIDDEN until pallass_entry_stamped (Papers for Pallass Stage 3, real arrival in Pallass) so this chain can't even be asked about before the player has actually stepped through. forge_tier_permit_asked is a non-beat signpost (heard_about_cisterns precedent) -- beat 1's own producer is permit_intro's 'File it.' option below, kept separate per the quest-start-is-never-a-beat convention.
options.text: I need clearance for the forge tier.

options._comment: Standing recap while waiting on Grimalkin's own beat (issue #74 precedent) -- non-banking, goto only.
options.text: Any word from the exam floor?

options._comment: Beat 3 entry, gated on Grimalkin's own examiner beat (grimalkin_examination_passed, data/dialogue/pallass_grimalkin.json).
options.text: The exam's done. About that stamp.

permit_intro.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
permit_intro.text: Five gold, filed same-day, no exceptions and no discounts -- that's the posted price. Grimalkin reads your fitness after, at the exam floor on the far end of this office; I only handle paper.

options._comment: Beat 1 real completion -- banks forge_permit_filed. Plain gold gate, posted-prices register (no haggling, docs/design/city-identity-bible.md).

permit_filed_reaction.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
permit_filed_reaction.text: Filed. Grimalkin's at the exam floor, far end of this office -- see him before you come back asking about a stamp.

permit_status.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
permit_status.text: Filed and pending. Grimalkin reads the fitness, not me -- he's at the exam floor, far end of this office. I stamp once he signs off, not before.

collect_stamp.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
collect_stamp.text: Grimalkin's mark is on the file. Three gold for the stamp itself -- posted price, same as the filing.

options._comment: Beat 3 real completion -- banks elevator_pass_stamped, THE producer B's elevator door pair's door_when gate waits on (controller ruling 1).

stamp_reaction.speaker: Forge-Tier Clerk
stamp_reaction.text: Stamped. The lift answers to it now -- don't lose the paper, I don't file duplicates.
